rulings.why: 067-strip0.jpg system 1, stanza 2 row: word 11 is 'Light' in 'O glorious Light,', a title of Christ after the vocative 'O'; it ends the 6-syllable poem line opened at 'Your' (word 7), and the next line opens at 'Till' (word 12). So the capital opens no line and the database's line 2 stands.
settles: 67 shape (shape2-08): stanza 2 row 1 prints word 11 with a capital inside a line of stanza 2, where no line or sentence opens
